summary: On a newly created Astral level, do.c:final_level() calls iter_mons(reset_hostility) before creating player-monsters and a guardian angel. priest.c:reset_hostility() marks non-coaligned minion Angels and aligned clerics hostile, updates their alignment value, and calls newsym() for each. The Astral arrival branch in js/do.js had recorded this call as unported, skipping the monster-state update and redraw. Porting the callback and wiring it into final_level() makes the complete admitted v65 recording match.

source.branch: reset_hostility processes only minions whose data is PM_ALIGNED_CLERIC or PM_ANGEL; when min_align differs from the hero alignment it clears peaceful and tame state and recomputes malign, then redraws the monster square.

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/do.c:2043-2049 defines final_level() as iter_mons(reset_hostility), create_mplayers(rn1(4, 3), TRUE), then gain_guardian_angel(); nethack-c/upstream/src/do.c:1882-1889 calls final_level() only for a newly created Astral level.

nethack-c/upstream/src/priest.c:755-770 returns for non-minions and non-Angels/non-aligned clerics; for a non-coaligned minion it clears mpeaceful and mtame and calls set_malign(), then calls newsym() at the monster coordinates.

At diagnosis commit 4de56bbde1493a876a505e22c65c88e49b6de1d8, js/do.js:3162-3169 follows the Astral arrival branch and calls note_unported('priest.c reset_hostility') before create_mplayers() and gain_guardian_angel(); js/priest.js has no reset_hostility implementation.

The saved v65 evaluation reports the first difference at segment 0, step 180, screen row 10 column 34: C renders glyph 5 in color 13 and JavaScript renders a blank cell in color 8. The same evaluation reports 6144/6144 RNG calls and 210/210 cursors matched, consistent with the missing redraw and state-only hostility update.

The recording recipe reaches this branch through #levelchange to a new Astral level after wizard-created peaceful Angels follow the hero; the next visible interaction opens the Amulet wish prompt. After implementation commit 0bdeab742, the focused scan reported no divergence and matched all 210 recorded steps; synthetic-range-evidence verified segment 0 through step 209.
